sources.prompt:
Production-ready 2D PIXEL-ART sprite sheet. Claudia Wolf in ORIGINAL Silent Hill 3 (2003), human version before any transformation. Adult pale woman, very long straight PALE BLONDE hair, nearly absent eyebrows, ankle-length plain BLACK high-neck long-sleeved dress, BARE FEET. Empty hands, subdued expression. Keep original normal human body. No staff, weapon, wings, demonic pregnancy, ritual wound, glowing hands, magical healing or offensive spell. Her selected team-support action is merely a restrained spoken instruction and a beckoning hand. Faithfully preserve this explicit ORIGINAL version in EVERY frame. Natural game proportions, full body head to feet, consistent face/costume and equipment. This is generated adaptation, not official ripped frames. Isolated fully TRANSPARENT background, no environment, grid lines, labels, text, ground, gradients, cast shadows or extra bodies. EXACTLY 8 columns and 6 rows, 48 SEPARATE DIFFERENT complete native character poses. Each row contains TWO four-frame sequences: columns1-4 sequenceA, columns5-8 sequenceB. Regular grid, generous transparent gutters. All feet and props inside own cell including bottom row. Same shared body pixel scale; crouching remains shorter than standing. Generally face SCREEN RIGHT.
ROW1 left half INTRO: four distinct cautious arriving/ready gestures; right half OUTRO: lower hands/weapon, turn and step away in four distinct stages.
ROW2 left half FIRST ROUND VICTORY: calm exhale, straighten, small acknowledgement, settle; right half FIRST ROUND DEFEAT: recoil, guarded crouch, one knee, recover. No visible injury.
ROW3 left half FINAL PRESENTATION: a restrained safe-route pointing gesture / spoken instruction with EMPTY hands, no effects; right half MATCH VICTORY: four distinct composed relief/acknowledgement poses with actual equipment low. No execution.
ROW4 left half MATCH DEFEAT: tired recoil, bent knee, kneeling, exhausted living posture; right half SUPER: a restrained safe-route pointing gesture / spoken instruction with EMPTY hands, no effects, four clearly different timing stages with the body and weapon visible.
ROW5 left half IDLE: four clearly distinct subtle stance/breathing/gaze poses; right half RUN: four actual different running steps.
ROW6 left half BASIC ACTION: a restrained safe-route pointing gesture / spoken instruction with EMPTY hands, no effects; right half LIGHT HIT: surprise, backward recoil, guarded dip, steady recovery.
No gore, blood, wounds, victims, dismemberment, attack against a child, fire, supernatural beam, magic shield or invented powers. ALL rows including action rows remain NONOFFENSIVE zero-damage support; never add an attack weapon, energy ball or glyph. Four frames per sequence must all differ; do not reuse drawings between sequences. ALL 48 cells must be present.

IMPORTANT CANVAS FIT: draw each standing person no taller than 115 pixels on a 1536x1024 landscape canvas. Exactly SIX fully visible rows fit; leave generous TRANSPARENT outer top/bottom margins. Bottom-row feet must end far above canvas edge. Shrink the character drawings uniformly to fit; NEVER crop feet or helmet. The grid cells are about192x160, not tall200-pixel figures.

calibration.notes: First complete standing native pose measured; all frames in this source retain one uniform scale.
